title: A Dad After God's Own Heart: Becoming the Father Your Kids Need
author: Jim George
target_audience: Men interested in spiritual growth within their families
core_themes: Building close, loving relationships with children
Modeling Christ-like character as a dad
Influencing children through faith and example
Balancing work, faith, and family life
primary_purpose: To encourage, inspire, and equip Christian fathers to become godly role models for their children by applying biblical wisdom and practical parenting strategies that foster spiritual growth and strong family bonds.

structure_format.organization: Divided into accessible chapters, each focusing on key aspects of dads’ spiritual roles and practical actions

key_concepts_lessons: A father's everyday actions profoundly shape a child's faith and character.
Spiritual leadership at home starts with the dad’s personal relationship with God.
Intentional involvement and presence foster stronger father-child relationships.
Communicating love, encouragement, and discipline with grace reflects God’s character.
Prioritizing prayer and scripture study enriches family life and sets a godly example.
Consistency, humility, and servant leadership are marks of a godly dad.
notable_features: Short, digestible chapters ideal for busy dads
Emphasis on biblical examples and practical steps
Focus on fostering spiritual legacy within the family
cultural_historical_context: Published during a period of renewed interest in intentional Christian parenting, the book reflects ongoing conversations in evangelical circles about the role of men and fathers amid modern family challenges.
reception_impact: Positively reviewed in Christian parenting circles and by family ministries
Praised for blending scriptural grounding with everyday application
Popular in church groups, men's ministries, and gift-giving for new fathers
Some criticism for limited appeal outside Christian or faith-based readers
comparable_titles: The Resolution for Men by Stephen and Alex Kendrick
Bringing Up Boys by Dr. James Dobson
